text_2: Documentation Journey Optimizer use-decisioning-in-email-channel Use Decisioning to personalize emailsUse Decisioning to personalize emails Use Decisioning to personalize emailsIn this tutorial, we will explore a real-world use case of sending personalized email offers using Adobe Journey Optimizer Decisioning.
